brief_description: Runs the stocksim market simulation and streams its events to scripts.
description:
Wraps the C++ simulation core: an order book with price-time priority, market/limit/stop/stop-limit orders, an event log, and time travel ([method step_back]). All market logic lives in the core; this node only translates.
Drive it manually with [method step_event] and [method step_tick], or continuously with [method run], which advances the simulation on a worker thread. Either way, read what happened by calling [method drain_events] every frame: each event is one row of [constant EVENT_STRIDE] integers in a [PackedInt64Array], indexed with the [code]EVENT_FIELD_*[/code] constants.
[codeblock]
var rows: PackedInt64Array = simulation.drain_events()
for base: int in range(0, rows.size(), Simulation.EVENT_STRIDE):
	var reason: int = rows[base + Simulation.EVENT_FIELD_REASON]
	print(Simulation.reason_text(reason))
[/codeblock]
Prices are integer ticks and quantities are integer lots; there is no floating point in market data. Events are never dropped: when the event buffer is full, the worker waits until it is drained, and manual stepping reports an error.
All methods must be called from the main thread. Queries return the state at the moment of the call; while running, that state may be ahead of the events drained so far.

methods.can_step_back: Returns [code]true[/code] if there is a step to undo with [method step_back].
methods.cancel_order: Queues a cancel of order [param order_id] on behalf of [param account]. The outcome arrives as an [constant EVENT_ORDER_CANCELLED] or [constant EVENT_COMMAND_REJECTED] event (for example [constant REASON_NOT_ORDER_OWNER]).
methods.configure: Replaces the simulation with a new one configured by [param scenario], a parsed scenario object (see [code]docs/scenario-format.md[/code]). Unknown keys, wrong types and out-of-range values are rejected. Stops any [method run] and discards undrained events. Returns [constant OK] or an error code, logging the reason.
methods.drain_events: Removes and returns up to [param max_events] of the oldest undelivered events (all of them if negative), as consecutive rows of [constant EVENT_STRIDE] integers. Call it every frame; draining also lets a paused worker continue.
methods.event_type_name: Returns the name of an event type, such as [code]"Match"[/code] for [constant EVENT_MATCH].
methods.get_best_ask: Returns the lowest resting sell price in ticks, or [code]0[/code] when there are no sell orders (check [method has_best_ask]).
methods.get_best_bid: Returns the highest resting buy price in ticks, or [code]0[/code] when there are no buy orders (check [method has_best_bid]).
methods.get_depth: Returns up to [param max_levels] (at most 4096) price levels on [param side], best price first, as rows of [constant DEPTH_STRIDE] integers indexed with the [code]DEPTH_FIELD_*[/code] constants.
methods.get_event_schema_version: Returns the version of the event layout. It changes whenever event fields, types or reasons change meaning.
methods.get_last_price: Returns the price of the most recent trade in ticks, or [code]0[/code] before the first trade (check [method has_last_price]). This is the market price: the last trade, not a measure of value.
methods.get_last_sequence: Returns the sequence number of the most recent event in the current state ([code]0[/code] before any event). After [signal rewound], discard any held event with a larger sequence number.
methods.get_account: Returns account [param account] as [constant ACCOUNT_STRIDE] integers indexed with the [code]ACCOUNT_FIELD_*[/code] constants, or an empty array if it has never been opened or traded. Cash is in price ticks x shares; positions are in shares.
methods.get_order: Returns the live order [param order_id] as [constant ORDER_STRIDE] integers indexed with the [code]ORDER_FIELD_*[/code] constants, or an empty array if it is not live (filled, cancelled, rejected, or not yet processed).
methods.get_pending_event_count: Returns the number of events waiting to be returned by [method drain_events].
methods.get_scenario_name: Returns the [code]name[/code] of the loaded scenario, or [code]"Default"[/code].
methods.get_steps_per_second: Returns the speed passed to the latest [method run] call ([code]0[/code] means unthrottled).
methods.get_tick_volume: Returns the quantity traded so far in the current tick.
methods.get_total_volume: Returns the total quantity traded since the simulation started.
methods.get_trade_count: Returns the number of trades since the simulation started.
methods.has_best_ask: Returns [code]true[/code] if any sell order is resting on the book.
methods.has_best_bid: Returns [code]true[/code] if any buy order is resting on the book.
methods.has_last_price: Returns [code]true[/code] once at least one trade has happened.
methods.has_redo: Returns [code]true[/code] after [method step_back] while there is recorded future that [method step_event] and [method step_tick] will replay. Any new order, cancel or modify discards it.
methods.is_running: Returns [code]true[/code] while [method run] is advancing the simulation.
methods.load_scenario: Reads a scenario JSON file at [param path] and applies it with [method configure]. Returns [constant OK] or an error code, logging the reason (including the line of a JSON syntax error).
methods.load_state: Replaces the simulation with one restored from [param data], as produced by [method save_state]. History is not restored, so [method can_step_back] is [code]false[/code] afterwards. Returns [constant OK], or [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] / [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] for data from another version or corrupt data.
methods.modify_order: Queues a change of resting order [param order_id] to [param new_limit_price] and [param new_qty]. Reducing quantity at the same price keeps the order's place in the queue; any price change or quantity increase moves it to the back, and it may trade immediately.
methods.pause: Stops a [method run]. The simulation keeps its state and can be stepped manually or run again.
methods.reason_text: Returns the fixed English explanation of a [code]REASON_*[/code] code, for narration.
methods.run: Starts advancing the simulation on a worker thread at [param steps_per_second] (a step is one event-producing step or one tick advance); [code]0[/code] runs as fast as possible. Calling it again changes the speed. Results do not depend on the speed or on timing: only on the inputs and their order.
methods.save_state: Returns the complete current market state as bytes, for [method load_state].
methods.step_back: Undoes the most recent step (and any orders, cancels or modifies given after it), then emits [signal rewound]. Returns [code]false[/code] at the beginning. Undelivered events from the undone future are discarded.
methods.step_event: Performs (or replays, after [method step_back]) one step, which emits at most four events. Returns [code]false[/code] if there was nothing to do. Fails with an error if the event buffer is full; call [method drain_events] first.
methods.step_tick: Performs steps until the tick advances. Returns [code]true[/code] when the tick advanced, or [code]false[/code] if it stopped early because the event buffer filled up; drain and call again to continue.
methods.submit_order: Queues a new order and returns its id. [param limit_price] is used by limit and stop-limit orders, [param stop_price] by stop and stop-limit orders; both are in ticks. The order is validated when processed: watch for [constant EVENT_ORDER_PLACED] or [constant EVENT_ORDER_REJECTED] with this id. Returns [code]0[/code] and logs an error if an argument is out of range.

signals.rewound: Emitted by [method step_back]. Events with a sequence number greater than [param last_sequence] no longer happened; remove them from anything that displays them.

constants.ORDER_TYPE_MARKET: Trades immediately against the book at the best available prices; any unfilled remainder is cancelled.
constants.ORDER_TYPE_LIMIT: Trades at the limit price or better; any unfilled remainder rests on the book.
constants.ORDER_TYPE_STOP: Waits until the last trade reaches the stop price, then becomes a market order.
constants.ORDER_TYPE_STOP_LIMIT: Waits until the last trade reaches the stop price, then becomes a limit order.
constants.ORDER_STATUS_PENDING_STOP: A stop order waiting for its stop price.
constants.ORDER_STATUS_TRIGGERED: A stop order whose stop price was reached, queued to become active.
constants.ORDER_STATUS_MATCHING: The order currently trading against the book.
constants.ORDER_STATUS_RESTING: An order resting on the book.
constants.EVENT_ORDER_PLACED: An order passed validation and was accepted.
constants.EVENT_ORDER_REJECTED: An order failed validation; it never existed on the book.
constants.EVENT_ORDER_RESTED: An order's unfilled remainder joined the book.
constants.EVENT_ORDER_CANCELLED: An order's remainder was removed, by its owner or for lack of liquidity.
constants.EVENT_ORDER_MODIFIED: A resting order's price or quantity was changed by its owner.
constants.EVENT_COMMAND_REJECTED: A cancel or modify could not be applied.
constants.EVENT_STOP_TRIGGERED: A stop order's stop price was reached.
constants.EVENT_MATCH: One trade between the incoming order (taker) and a resting order (maker). Always followed by two [constant EVENT_FILL] events, taker first.
constants.EVENT_FILL: One side of a trade, from one order's point of view.
constants.EVENT_PRICE_CHANGE: The last trade price changed. [constant EVENT_FIELD_AUX_PRICE] holds the previous price.
constants.REASON_INVALID_QUANTITY: Rejected: the quantity is not positive or is too large.
constants.REASON_INVALID_LIMIT_PRICE: Rejected: the limit price is not positive or is too large.
constants.REASON_INVALID_STOP_PRICE: Rejected: the stop price is not positive or is too large.
constants.REASON_RESTING_ON_BOOK: The unfilled quantity waits on the book.
constants.REASON_CANCELLED_BY_OWNER: Cancelled by the account that placed it.
constants.REASON_NO_LIQUIDITY: Remainder cancelled: nothing left on the other side to trade with.
constants.REASON_UNKNOWN_ORDER: No live order has this id.
constants.REASON_NOT_ORDER_OWNER: Only the placing account may change or cancel an order.
constants.REASON_NOT_MODIFIABLE: Only resting orders can be modified.
constants.REASON_MODIFIED_KEPT_PRIORITY: Quantity reduced at the same price; queue position kept.
constants.REASON_MODIFIED_LOST_PRIORITY: Price changed or quantity increased; moved to the back of the queue.
constants.REASON_STOP_PRICE_REACHED: The last trade reached the stop price.
constants.REASON_TRADE: Incoming order traded with a resting order at the resting order's price.
constants.REASON_LAST_TRADE_PRICE: The market price is the last trade price.
constants.REASON_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: The account cannot afford the order with its cash and leverage.
constants.REASON_INSUFFICIENT_SHARES: The account does not hold enough uncommitted shares to sell (no short selling).
constants.EVENT_FIELD_SEQ: Global sequence number; strictly increasing by one.
constants.EVENT_FIELD_TICK: Tick in which the event happened.
constants.EVENT_FIELD_INTENT: Broker intent tag; [code]0[/code] (none) until the broker layer exists.
constants.EVENT_FIELD_SIDE: A [enum Side] value for the primary order.
constants.EVENT_FIELD_ORDER_TYPE: An [enum OrderType] value for the primary order.
constants.EVENT_FIELD_ORDER_ID: The primary order (the taker, for matches).
constants.EVENT_FIELD_COUNTER_ORDER_ID: The other order involved, if any (the maker, for matches).
constants.EVENT_FIELD_COUNTER_ACCOUNT: Account of the other order, if any.
constants.EVENT_FIELD_PRICE: Price in ticks; meaning depends on the type (execution price, limit price, new last price).
constants.EVENT_FIELD_AUX_PRICE: Secondary price in ticks: the stop price, the previous price after a modify, or the previous last price.
constants.EVENT_FIELD_QTY: Quantity: executed, cancelled, rested or ordered, depending on the type.
constants.EVENT_FIELD_REMAINING: The primary order's remaining quantity after the event.
constants.EVENT_STRIDE: Number of integers per event row returned by [method drain_events].
constants.ORDER_FIELD_LIMIT_PRICE: Limit price in ticks ([code]0[/code] if none).
constants.ORDER_FIELD_STOP_PRICE: Stop price in ticks ([code]0[/code] if none).
constants.ORDER_STRIDE: Number of integers returned by [method get_order] for a live order.
constants.DEPTH_FIELD_QTY: Total quantity resting at this price.
constants.DEPTH_FIELD_ORDER_COUNT: Number of orders resting at this price.
constants.DEPTH_STRIDE: Number of integers per row returned by [method get_depth].
constants.ACCOUNT_FIELD_CASH: Cash balance (may be negative when trading on leverage).
constants.ACCOUNT_FIELD_LIMITED: [code]1[/code] if the account was opened with limits (buying power and no short selling), [code]0[/code] if unlimited.
constants.ACCOUNT_FIELD_COMMITTED_BUY: Cash reserved by resting buy orders.
constants.ACCOUNT_FIELD_COMMITTED_SELL: Shares reserved by resting sell orders and pending sell stops.
constants.ACCOUNT_STRIDE: Number of integers returned by [method get_account] for a known account.
